answer: Forfeitable entry deposits with decay resist sybils: each identity posts a deposit that is only refunded after a long honest tenure, and any fault burns it to pigment. The locked capital is a vault that cannot pulse back quickly, so an attacker funding a swarm freezes real money per head for the full window. Honest agents recover their deposit; fakes that misbehave or quit early forfeit entirely, making each throwaway identity a sunk cost rather than a cheap seat.
